text:
The fed funds rate is 4.83% after a 50bp drop over 3 months, and the 12-month change is also -0.5. That points to late 2024: the Fed cut 100bp in total in Sep-Dec 2024, taking the rate from 5.33 to 4.33. At 4.83 it would be around Oct-Nov 2024, when the monthly average was 4.83 in October and 4.64 in November.

Other cues match October 2024. The 10-year yield at 4.29% is consistent with end-October (4.28%), with a 3m change of +0.20 (from 3.91 at end-July... roughly). The 2-year at 4.15% also fits end-October. Core CPI at 3.26% is September's reading (3.3%), and headline CPI at 2.41% is also September's (2.4%). The unemployment rate of 4.1% was the September figure. Payrolls were weak in October, but the September data were published before the snapshot. Bonds fell 3.5% in the month, which fits October 2024, and the S&P was flat at -0.0% that month. The 12-month equity return of 37.8% also fits.

The month is October 2024.
